problem:
The vectors ${a}_{1},$ ${a}_{2},$ and ${a}_{3}$ are given below. Determine whether $B={{a}_{1},{a}_{2}}$ is a basis of $\text{Span}{{a}_{1},{a}_{2},{a}_{3}}.$ If that is the case, find ${x}_{1}\cdot {x}_{2},$ where ${a}_{3}={x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}.$

$$
{a}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 6\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}9 \\ 18\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{3}=[\begin{aligned}-6 \\ 12\end{aligned}]
$$

activity_context.topic_title: Finding a Basis of a Span

feedback.problem:
The vectors ${a}_{1},$ ${a}_{2},$ and ${a}_{3}$ are given below. Determine whether $B={{a}_{1},{a}_{2}}$ is a basis of $\text{Span}{{a}_{1},{a}_{2},{a}_{3}}.$ If that is the case, find ${x}_{1}\cdot {x}_{2},$ where ${a}_{3}={x}_{1}{a}_{1}+{x}_{2}{a}_{2}.$

$$
{a}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -3\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 6\end{aligned}],\,{a}_{3}=[\begin{aligned}8 \\ 12\end{aligned}]
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
We want to determine if $B$ is indeed a basis of $\text{Span}{{a}_{1},{a}_{2},{a}_{3}}.$ So, we want to find ${x}_{1},{x}_{2}\in R$ such that 

$$
{x}_{1}{{[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -3\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{{a}_{1}}+{x}_{2}{{[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 6\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{{a}_{2}}={{[\begin{aligned}8 \\ 12\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{{a}_{3}}.
$$

This equation is equivalent to the system

$$
{\begin{aligned}{x}_{1}+2{x}_{2}=8 \\ -3{x}_{1}+6{x}_{2}=12\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we reduce the augmented matrix of the system to reduced row echelon form (RREF):

$$
\begin{aligned} & \,\,[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 8 \\ -3 & 6 & 12\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :={R}_{2}+3{R}_{1} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 8 \\ 0 & 12 & 36\end{aligned}] & {R}_{2} & :=\frac{1}{12}{R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 2 & 8 \\ 0 & 1 & 3\end{aligned}] & {R}_{1} & :={R}_{1}+(-2){R}_{2} \\  & ∼[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 & 2 \\ 0 & 1 & 3\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

From the RREF matrix above, we see that the pivot columns are the $1$st and $2$nd columns. So,  $B$ is indeed a basis of $\text{Span}{{a}_{1},{a}_{2},{a}_{3}}.$
Also, the matrix tells us that ${x}_{1}=2$ and ${x}_{2}=3,$ meaning that

$$
2\cdot {{[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -3\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{{a}_{1}}+3\cdot {{[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 6\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{{a}_{2}}={{[\begin{aligned}8 \\ 12\end{aligned}]}_{⏟}}_{{a}_{3}}.
$$

Therefore, ${x}_{1}\cdot {x}_{2}=2\cdot 3=6.$
